subject: scatterplot of the same variable in 2 categories

messages.author: 4f6f5f995ee31178
messages.subject: scatterplot of the same variable in 2 categories
parts:
Hi!
I have data with an structure such as in this example:
x <- 1:100
y <- x^2*0.1 + runif(100,-10,10)
testdata1 <- data.frame(ID=1,ind="A",X=x,Y=y)
y <- x^2*0.01 + runif(100,-10,10)
testdata2 <- data.frame(ID=1,ind="B",X=x,Y=y)
testdata <- rbind(testdata1,testdata2)

After plotting y against x in ggplot, ie:
ggplot() + geom_line(data=testdata,aes(x=X,y=Y,colour=ind,group=ind))
+ facet_wrap(~ID)
(in practice I have ~12 IDs, hence the facet_wrap)

I would like to plot the y values oA against the y values of B , with ind
as facet_wrap. Is this possible with ggplot and the current structure
of the dataset or should I re-structure the data.frame to have 2
separated y variables? or should I rather go back to standard
graphics (i.e. making a for loop)?

Thanks

Agus

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: scatterplot of the same variable in 2 categories
parts:
Is this what you wanted?

DF <- data.frame(x = seq(100),
y1 = seq(100)^2*0.1 + runif(100,-10,10),
y2 = seq(100)^2*0.01 + runif(100,-10,10))

ggplot(DF, aes(x = y1, y = y2)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth()

Dennis

the data to introduce 2 variables) and I'm wondering if it could be
avoided

testdata1 <- testdata[ind=="A",]
testdata2 <- testdata[ind=="B"]
testdatanew <- cbind(testdata1[,1:3],A_Y=testdata1[,4],B_Y=testdata2[,4])
ggplot() + geom_points(data=testdatanew,aes(x=A_Y, y=B_Y)) + facet_wrap(~ID)

Agus
